episode.observableAction: On a humid Saturday morning in the apartment, the caregiver calls the subject over from the floor where the subject and the younger sibling have been lining up plastic animal toys. The caregiver points to a small plastic basin and a short clothesline strung across the balcony, then hands the subject a bundle of cloths and a plastic clip hanger. The caregiver demonstrates once by clipping a wet cloth to the line, then steps back and tells the subject to hang the rest while the caregiver returns to a basin of laundry. The subject carries the bundle to the balcony doorway, shakes out each damp cloth, and clips them one by one onto the hanger and the line, stretching on tiptoe for the higher spots. A couple of cloths slip off and fall to the balcony floor; the subject picks them up, re-clips them more carefully, and checks that they stay in place. The younger sibling stands in the doorway watching and occasionally pointing at a crooked cloth. When the last cloth is hanging, the subject calls out to the caregiver. The caregiver comes over, looks along the line of cloths, adjusts one corner, and nods before taking the empty basin back toward the bathroom.

Late on a warm morning in the apartment, the subject and the younger sibling sit on the cool tile floor near the balcony door with a single plastic toy truck between them. The subject rolls the truck back and forth along an imaginary road marked by a line in the tile, making engine noises. The younger sibling reaches out, grabs the truck, and starts pushing it in circles, bumping it against the subject’s knee. The subject pulls the truck back and lines it up on the tile line again, saying a short phrase and nudging the sibling’s hand away. The sibling frowns, grabs for the truck more forcefully, and tries to steer it toward a plastic cup. The truck jerks between their hands, the cup tips over, and a few small blocks spill out and scatter. The subject tightens their grip and pulls the truck toward their own side of the floor, turning their shoulder to block the sibling. The sibling raises their voice and tugs harder on the back of the truck, the wheels scraping loudly on the tile. From the nearby kitchen area, the caregiver calls out, then steps into the room, wipes their hands on a towel, and looks down at the two children holding the same truck. The caregiver crouches, gently takes hold of the truck, and pauses until both children loosen their grip. The caregiver says a few firm words, then sets the truck down between them and points first to the subject, then to the sibling, miming a turn-taking motion with their hand. The subject picks up the truck, rolls it along the tile line for a short run, then stops and pushes it toward the sibling. The sibling takes it, drives it in a small circle near the spilled blocks, then pushes it back. The caregiver watches for a moment, nods once, and returns to the kitchen while the two children continue alternating short turns with the truck.

episode.observableAction: On a warm weekday morning at the neighborhood school gate, the nearby adult relative parks a motorbike among a row of others and walks the subject toward the entrance, carrying the subject’s small backpack by one strap. Near the gate, the relative stops, hands the backpack to the subject, and points toward the line of students forming in front of a classroom. The subject slips the backpack on, adjusts one shoulder strap, and looks over at the relative. The relative raises a hand in a brief wave and steps back toward the motorbike area. The subject joins the end of the line of children in similar uniforms, glances once more toward the gate where the relative is putting on a helmet, then faces forward as a teacher begins calling the class inside.

On a late Sunday morning at the neighborhood market, the caregiver and nearby adult relative stand near a vegetable stall while the subject and younger sibling wait by the motorbike parking area. The caregiver pulls a folded 20,000₫ note from a pocket, calls the subject over, and points toward a nearby stall with a hand-lettered sign for bread. The caregiver says the name of the bread, holds up two fingers, and tells the subject to go buy it, adding a brief reminder to watch for motorbikes. The subject nods, takes the note, and walks alone along the crowded aisle, stepping around baskets of greens and passing a woman arranging fish on ice. Reaching the bread stall, the subject waits behind one customer, then steps up to the counter and asks the vendor for two loaves, holding up two fingers. The vendor picks up two small baguettes, slips them into a thin plastic bag, and names the price. The subject hands over the note, receives a few coins in change, and tucks them into a shorts pocket. Carrying the bag, the subject retraces the path past the fish and vegetable stalls, pauses at the edge of a stream of motorbikes rolling through the lane, then crosses back to the parking area. The caregiver looks over as the subject approaches, takes the bag, peeks inside to check the contents, and gives a short verbal acknowledgment before turning back to the relative to continue discussing what else to buy. The subject stays near the motorbike with the younger sibling, occasionally glancing toward the stalls while the adults finish their shopping.

episode.observableAction: On a late morning at the Cần Thơ public library, the subject walks past a row of low shelves in the children’s section, scanning the spines of several thin Vietnamese books with colorful covers. The subject pauses, pulls out one book with a bright illustration of a river and boats on the front, flips it open to the middle, glances at a page, then slides it back into place. Moving a few steps along the shelf, the subject tilts their head to read another cluster of titles, reaches for a slightly thicker paperback that shows a cartoon boy holding a magnifying glass, and opens it near the beginning. After turning a couple of pages while standing in the aisle, the subject looks toward a nearby table with empty chairs, tucks the magnifying-glass book under one arm, and leaves the other books on the shelf untouched as they walk over to sit down with the chosen book in front of them.

episode.observableAction: On a warm Saturday morning in the apartment’s main room, the subject sits on the floor near the balcony door with a small stack of thin comic books spread out in front of them. The younger sibling comes over from the television, drops to the floor beside the subject, and reaches toward a comic with a bright red cover showing a superhero. The subject places a hand lightly on that book, slides it back into the middle of the stack, and instead fans out three comics on the tile: one with animals on the cover, one with schoolchildren, and the red superhero comic. Pointing to each cover in turn, the subject briefly names or describes it, then taps the covers with an open palm and looks at the sibling. The sibling hesitates, glances between the animals and the superhero, and finally taps the superhero comic with one finger. The subject nods, gathers the other two comics into a small pile off to the side, and leaves the chosen superhero comic in front of the sibling. The sibling lies on their stomach and opens it, while the subject picks up one of the remaining comics and leans back against the wall to read. For a moment they both turn pages quietly, the stack of unused comics resting between them on the floor.
